meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建或编辑自定义视频组合，用于多场景、品牌片、蒙太奇等
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行专业视频创作而无现成模板可用
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need professional video creation with no pre-built template

howto.what: Claude 可以创建或编辑 HyperFrames 视频合成项目，包括多场景短片、品牌视频、蒙太奇等。它会先检查项目状态，然后生成计划、构建场景、处理媒体资源，并支持自动化或协作流程。
howto.when: 当没有专门的视频工作流适合，或 BRIEF.md 中指定 flow: companion 时触发。适用于长视频、多场景、品牌宣传片等。

say.text: 帮我创建一个三场景的品牌宣传视频。
say.note: Claude 会开始新项目，生成计划并构建场景。

say.text: 把这段素材混剪成30秒精彩集锦。
say.note: Claude 会根据素材剪辑并添加过渡效果。

say.text: 编辑之前创建的视频项目，添加旁白。
say.note: Claude 会加载现有项目并执行修改。

howto.what_en: Claude can create or edit HyperFrames video compositions, including multi-scene shorts, brand videos, montages, etc. It checks project state, generates a plan, builds scenes, handles media assets, and supports automation or companion flows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized video workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Used for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, etc.

say_en.text: Create a 3-scene brand promo video for me.
say_en.note: Claude starts a new project, generates a plan, and builds scenes.

say_en.text: Remix this footage into a 30-second highlight reel.
say_en.note: Claude edits the footage and adds transitions.

say_en.text: Edit my previous video project and add narration.
say_en.note: Claude loads the existing project and applies changes.
